in_marathi.name: Vidhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vidhu means "knowledge, wisdom" in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vidh' which means 'to know'. This name is often given to children who are believed to possess great knowledge or intelligence.
